label: Большой / Маленький
description: Size contrasts for houses, objects, and everyday observation.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Basic masculine agreement. 1. 'Большой' matches 'дом'. 2. The phrase is one of the simplest size pairs in Russian. 3. It is easy to see, say, and type.
Strategic focus: Feminine agreement. 1. 'Маленькая' matches 'комната'. 2. The sentence is concrete and household-friendly. 3. This is a very common descriptive pattern.
Strategic focus: Neuter agreement. 1. 'Большое' matches the neuter noun 'окно'. 2. The sentence trains the learner to switch endings. 3. It stays visually simple and useful.
Strategic focus: Masculine noun pair. 1. 'Маленький' matches 'стол'. 2. The sentence is short but still grammatical. 3. It is a good anchor for swapping in other household nouns.

Strategic focus: Contrast across two nouns. 1. The adjective form changes because the nouns are different genders. 2. The sentence gives a strong urban-rural image. 3. This is a useful future template for comparative practice.
